spec.situation_desc: had a mortgage payment taken on the wrong date

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Owen speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Yasmin Kowalski. My mortgage payment’s been taken on the wrong date, and I’m really unhappy about how this has been handled.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll need to verify you first. What’s your date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. What date was the payment taken?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It came out on the 18th. It should have been the 25th. I didn’t agree to that, and this has caused a lot of hassle.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right. It’ll be returned to your account, so that should sort it.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: You haven’t even checked what happened. I want someone to take this seriously.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can see the payment was collected on the 18th. I’ll put a note on the account.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s all? I’ve already had to call about this once.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: The account shows the payment date was changed. I can’t see more here.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I’m not satisfied with that. The bank has taken it on the wrong date and I’ve had no proper explanation.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: We’ll send a full written response within eight weeks explaining what happens next.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So I just wait for a letter, then?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes, a full written response within eight weeks. Is there anything else?
